decision: Keep the 2pc on the existing generic path: ntesim_data::stat_projection applies the Lakshana_2 additive pack (+0.1 DamageUpLakshanaBase, empty ConditionArray) once set_count reaches the SuitStructList threshold, and build projection places it in elemental_bonuses[LAKSHANA] inside the single summed DMG-bonus zone (M_bonus = 1 + general + matching element + ...). No set-specific proc is introduced.
hypothesis_rationale: The frozen Suit5 row names pack Lakshana_2 for SuitCondition 2; DT_EquipmentModifyData defines it as one additive +0.1 DamageUpLakshanaBase entry with an empty ConditionArray, which the shared additive-pack interpreter accepts as an unconditional static pack. Threshold gating (set_count >= 2) and empty-ConditionArray acceptance are the generic, already-reviewed stat_projection rules, not new Street Boxer claims. The +10% sits in the same summed damage-bonus zone as general bonuses per COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 1 (crates/core/src/combat/damage.rs adds the matching elemental bonus into total_dmg_bonus before forming 1 + total).
